newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Kesko/Tuko deal must be changed - EU source.
newsitem.headline: Kesko/Tuko deal must be changed - EU source.

text.p: The acquisition by Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy of rival company Tuko Oy needs to be changed in order to win European Commission clearance, an EU source on Wednesday.

This was no surprise since the Commission clearly said in July, when it started a so-called second stage investigation, that it had serious doubts about the impact of the operation on competition in the Finnish market, the source stressed.
"Yes, of course, it will be changed," the source said in response to a question on whether the deal needed to be modified.
"Why do we enter a second stage? It is because we have problems and we want remedies," the source added. The Commission must take its final decision by the end of November.

Kesko CEO Eero Kinnunen said earlier on Wednesday he hoped the Commission would approve the deal after it was changed. Kinnunen said he thought these would concern the relation between Kesko and Finnish retailers.
